stem: According to the selection, how do fish protect themselves from dolphins?

options.label: A
options.text: They bury themselves beneath the sand along the sea floor.

options.label: B
options.text: They take cover under sharp rocks and pieces of coral.

options.label: C
options.text: They swim in a darting pattern in the open water.

options.label: D
options.text: They make a ringing noise that tricks dolphins.
